title: lvgl26 settings
description: The settings file of a program built with lvgl26: lvgl26_settings(target lvgl26.json).

allow.description: What the program may use. Everything is allowed by default.

allocation.description: Memory from the system heap while the program runs: new, malloc, a standard container that grows, the frame of a task. LVGL's own fixed pool is not the system heap.

threads.description: Threads, and the locks between them.

files.description: Files and the standard streams: fopen, stdin, stdout.

floating_point.description: Floating-point arithmetic while the program runs. The compiler still uses it to make fonts, pictures and tokens.

rules.description: The library's own strictness. Everything is strict by default.

raw_style_values.description: Plain values such as 8 * lv::px in styles, beside design tokens.

raw_integer_state.description: A state, a computed value or a row field of a plain integer, beside a quantity, an lv::counter or a named type.

tokens_legacy_values.description: The forms of a token value from before the Design Tokens Format 2025.10: "#3366ff" for a color, "8px" or a bare number for a dimension, "200ms" for a duration. Only for the time a project's files convert: tools/dtcg_fix.py rewrites a token file.

compile_time_image.description: The largest picture that the compiler decodes. Decoding costs compile time: about a second for 48 x 48, many for a whole screen.
